tools.name: shippit_get_merchant
tools.description: The Shippit merchant account behind this API key: store and company name, contact, preparation time, website and the home (pickup) address with country. GET /merchant.

tools.name: shippit_get_operating_hours
tools.description: The store operating hours per weekday (open flag, start and end of the working day) that Shippit uses for pickup and delivery estimates. GET /merchants/settings/locations/operating_hours.

tools.name: shippit_list_webhooks
tools.description: The tracking webhooks configured on the account (at most 6): url, the order states that trigger each, whether address or receiver details are hidden, enabled flag. Custom header values are masked by Shippit. GET /merchants/webhooks.

tools.name: shippit_get_quotes
tools.description: Ask the carriers enabled on the account for a price and delivery estimate to a destination, for given parcels. Nothing is booked and nothing is charged. Set return_all_quotes to see every carrier instead of only the cheapest or fastest. A 200 can hold per-carrier errors (success false) and a quote o

tools.name: shippit_estimate_delivery_dates
tools.description: Estimated delivery window (earliest, latest, confidence and a ready-to-show text) per service level (standard, express) between two postcodes, optionally limited to some carriers. Returns an empty list if no carrier is enabled. POST /estimated_delivery_dates.

tools.name: shippit_get_order
tools.description: One Shippit order by tracking number: state, courier and price allocated, delivery address, receiver, parcels, products, references and (once booked) manifest id and number. There is no list-orders endpoint in the Shippit API. GET /orders/{tracking_number}.

tools.name: shippit_get_tracking
tools.description: The status history of an order (status, date, time, who changed it) and the public tracking page URL to give the recipient. GET /orders/{tracking_number}/tracking.

tools.name: shippit_get_manifest_document
tools.description: The booking manifest document for a manifest id (from shippit_book_orders or shippit_get_order): carrier, order count, tracking numbers and a pre-signed PDF URL valid for 7 days. A 422 means the manifest is still generating: retry shortly. GET /book/{manifest_id}/document.

tools.name: shippit_create_order
tools.description: WRITE: create a domestic shipping order in Shippit. Shippit then allocates a carrier (your account rules, or the carrier named in courier_allocation) and, unless suppress_communications is true, emails the recipient tracking notifications. Requires confirm: true. Standard, express and click-and-coll

tools.name: shippit_label_order
tools.description: WRITE: confirm an order for shipping and fetch its label. tools.description: WRITE: book labelled orders with their carriers for pickup (the Shippit 'book' step). Shippit returns one manifest per carrier; the carrier then collects and bills the parcels. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shippit_list_webhooks, shippit_get_quotes, shippit_estimate_delivery_dates, shippit_get_tracking, shippit_get_manifest_document, shippit_label_order · Private data: shippit_get_merchant, shippit_get_manifest_document, shippit_label_order · Public sink: shippit_get_quotes, shippit_estimate_delivery_dates, shippit_create_order, shippit_book_orders · Destructive: shippit_cancel_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shippit_list_webhooks, shippit_get_quotes, shippit_estimate_delivery_dates, shippit_get_tracking, shippit_get_manifest_document, shippit_label_order · Private data: shippit_get_merchant, shippit_get_manifest_document, shippit_label_order · Public sink: shippit_get_quotes, shippit_estimate_delivery_dates, shippit_create_order, shippit_book_orders · Destructive: shippit_cancel_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
